pois.name: Museo della Bussola e del Ducato Marinaro
pois.description: È stato appena realizzato un nuovo allestimento del museo.

pois.name: Duomo di Amalfi
pois.intro: Amalfi Cathedral is a medieval Roman Catholic cathedral in the Piazza del Duomo, Amalfi, Italy. It is dedicated to the Apostle Saint Andrew whose relics are kept here.

pois.name: Villa Rufolo
pois.description: Former seat of powerful Rufolo family, historic villa and gardens. Restred by Nevile Reid in C19th.
pois.intro: Villa Rufolo is a villa within the historic center of Ravello, a town in the province of Salerno, southern Italy, which overlooks the front of the cathedral square. The initial layout dates from the 13th century, with extensive remodeling in the 19th century.

pois.name: Basilica del Crocifisso - Museo Diocesiano
pois.intro: The Diocesan Museum of Amalfi is an art museum housed in the 9th century Basilica del Crocifisso di Amalfi in Amalfi. It displays many of the treasures of the Archdiocese of Amalfi-Cava de' Tirreni and is centrally located close to Amalfi Cathedral in Via Salita Episcopio.

pois.name: Villa Cimbrone
pois.description: Historic villa with famous formal Italian garden. The gardens are open to the public, the villa is a hotel.
pois.intro: Villa Cimbrone is a historic villa in Ravello, on the Amalfi Coast of southern Italy. Dating from at least the 11th century, it is famous for its scenic belvedere, the Terrazza dell'Infinito.

pois.name: Grotta dello Smeraldo
pois.intro: The Grotta dello Smeraldo is a cave, partly inundated by the sea and located in Conca dei Marini, Italy, on the Amalfi Coast.

pois.name: Museo della Carta
pois.intro: Le Musée du papier d’Amalfi est une ex-papeterie transformée en musée en 1969 par la volonté de Nicola Milano, propriétaire de la papeterie et appartenant à une des familles amalfitaines célèbres pour avoir été opérantes dans la production et dans la fabrication du papier d’Amalfi.

pois.name: Arsenale di Amalfi
pois.intro: L'arsenale della Repubblica è un arsenale marittimo volto alla produzione e riparazione delle galee dell'antica Repubblica di Amalfi. Oggi è uno spazio espositivo e museale di Amalfi.

pois.name: Villa Marittima Romana
pois.intro: The Villa Romana or Roman Villa is an archaeological site dating from the 1st century in the Italian village of Minori, in Campania.

pois.name: Castello di San Nicola de Thoroplano
pois.wikipedia: it:Castello di San Nicola de Thoro-Plano
pois.intro: Das Castello di San Nicola de Thoro-Plano ist eine Burg aus dem 9. Jahrhundert in Maiori in der italienischen Region Kampanien.

pois.name: Castello di Gragnano
pois.intro: Das Castello di Gragnano ist eine Burgruine aus dem 10. Jahrhundert in Gragnano in der italienischen Region Kampanien.

pois.name: Agricola Ruocco's Lemon Experience
pois.description: A full Lemon Experience walking through the Lemon's Pergolas, and tasting any kind of Lemon like Lemon marmalade, Lemon sleush, Lemon juice, Lemon dessert.

pois.name: La Fattoria del Castello
pois.description: Local production of Mozzarella and different kind of cheese from local tradition - Cooking class experience about Mozzarela making

pois.name: Le Formichelle
pois.description: Lemon Tour & Lemon taste experience, own produxtion of local food-delicatessen: Limoncello IGP Amalfi coast, Fennel liqueur, Lemon Jam IGP Amalfi coast, Lemon cream IGP Amalfi coast, and local olive oil available too.

pois.name: Castello di Montalto
pois.intro: Das Castello di Montalto, auch Castello Trivento genannt, ist eine Burgruine aus dem 9. Jahrhundert in Tramonti in der italienischen Region Kampanien.
